title: Resolve Existing Development-Log Fleet Policy Failures Through Governed Collation
body:
The canonical Repository_Management pre-PR runner fails shared_scripts/development_log.py on unchanged docs/development/DEVELOPMENT_LOG.md from upstream main. It reports invalid or missing Last verified SHA fields, missing State/Owner fields (including DL-#9349), 143 active entries against a ceiling of75, and more than200000bytes. The shot-pattern branch does not edit this shared log; it supplies a per-PR change fragment.

## Acceptance Criteria

Repair field provenance and archive/park/ship entries through the governed collation workflow with owner-confirmed statuses. Do not fabricate verification SHAs, park other live sessions or loosen budgets to green the gate. Verify development_log.py and canonical fleet gate.

## Handoff

Baseline release blocker discovered during codex/shot-pattern-analysis validation. Not included in that feature PR closure list; keep open until a separately evidenced governed correction.
